title: Persist do-all completion standard
measurement_note: Timing record was created after the task began, so phases are recorded as completed but not measured.

phases.label: Web-first intake
phases.bottleneck_notes: Searched completion and definition-of-done references before changing durable rules.

phases.label: Memory bootstrap update
phases.bottleneck_notes: Updated the memory bootstrap manifest so the do-all standard remains discoverable.

phases.label: Mode, boundary, and plan
phases.bottleneck_notes: Classified the work as governance because it changes durable cross-workspace behavior.

phases.label: Implementation
phases.bottleneck_notes: Updated AGENTS.md, persistent instructions, omission workflow, and memory bootstrap config.

phases.label: Verification
phases.bottleneck_notes: Ran docs audit, config contract, JSON parse, git diff check, and memory bootstrap check.

phases.label: Evaluation and close-out records
phases.bottleneck_notes: Recorded request summary, web search, request trace, work summary, omission check, and evaluation.

phases.label: Commit and push
phases.bottleneck_notes: Covered by the current close-out commit and push gate.

bottleneck_analysis.interpretation: No exact timings were measured. Verification had the most tool surface because the change touched docs, workflow text, JSON config, and memory bootstrap readiness.
improvement_candidates: Use a small helper for durable-instruction changes that creates mode, timing, omission, evaluation, and trace records together.
Keep memory bootstrap validation in the same close-out gate whenever persistent behavior changes.
